weekly_submissions.challenger_comments: so this is day 1, i am in Utah for work this week so have access to gym and great food options in the office. travelling back on Thursday this week so Jet Lag sleep etc will make it a fun week will ensure to try and get steps and eat calerories/ protein tagets,

I was away over the weekend last weekend in Frankfurt with my son, focused on steps and trying to keep the 3 goals, i was a bit short on the protein. steps i covered 100K over the 3 days and managed 2 runs.

Rest of the week after a slower day on the Monday i have ran, strength or class. I have managed to hit all the goals, finding time for the steps can be a challenge but i am making it work.

Food wise i have felt hungry a few days but sticking with it, i am feeling a difference in my clothes and my body shape.
